description: This file sets up an Axios client for API interactions in a React frontend, including environment configuration, request interceptors for JWT token injection, and response interceptors for error handling.

methods.name: Axios.create
methods.description: Creates a new Axios instance with custom configuration.

methods.name: api.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to include JWT token in headers.

methods.name: api.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor for error handling and logout event dispatch.
